usedFor: 99 Acres produces the leads and Memory stores them, with “New Leads” feeding the “Memory” key-value action.

bestTemplate.name: “New Leads” in 99 Acres, then “Memory” in Memory
bestTemplate.why: Each new lead is saved as a key-value entry in Workspace Memory, ready for later lookups.

watchOut: “Delete Records” removes records from Workspace Memory, so keep it off the “New Leads” trigger unless clearing is intended.
